title: Hadrian
description: Industrial navy: one deep navy page with white ink, a single machined gold for labels, frames and the one solid button, a pale sky blue for hairline frames and a richer blue for media. Square corners, 1px white or gold hairlines, a tight neutral grotesk, an uppercase mono for every label and a wide grotesk for wordmarks.
notes: dark is the faithful mode; light is a sibling (pale grey page, navy ink and hairlines, the same gold)
Hanken Grotesk stands in for Söhne, DM Mono for Söhne Mono, Encode Sans Expanded for Söhne Breit (all closed)
font-display is the wide face: meant for wordmarks and marquees, not for headings (headings use font-sans)
page gutter widens from 1rem to 3.75rem at 1024px
